name: Keyes
source:
Keyes comes from a storied line of grand pianos. Name a big venue and someone in her family has graced the stage. Much like her actual keys, her outlook on life is black and white. You're either a renowned performer at the top of your game or you're a failure and you should launch yourself directly into the garbage. You'll need patience and understanding to let Keyes be the personality she needs to be.
Likes: Classical Music 
Dislikes: Dissonance

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
